title: wg: protocol-06 §7.5 ParticipantListUpdate apply rules unspecified
description: Suggestion. §7.5 ParticipantListUpdate (changedRoleParticipants, removedIndices, addedParticipants) does not say whether removedIndices refer to the list before or after role changes, how removals shift later indices, how out-of-range or duplicate indices are handled, or whether a user may appear twice. The result is group state, so members applying differently diverge. Related to room-policy JoinLinksUpdate (mimid-1wgh.37.29). Fix: specify order (e.g. changes, then removals by pre-update index, then appends) and error cases.
